title: Incendios_PY: a reproducible decoupled GeoAI framework for wildfire ignition and propagation benchmarking in the Gran Chaco
description: Open-source pipeline for daily 1-km wildfire ignition and propagation modelling in Paraguay. The release includes code for D2 target construction, biophysical gating, M3/M1 fallback inference, monotonic Platt calibration, spatial block validation, grouped bootstrap, and benchmarking against the full Canadian FWI and INPE Risco de Fogo. Raw third-party datasets are documented but not redistributed; processed data and trained models are deposited separately.
notes: Code archive. Processed data and trained models are deposited separately with their own DOI. Third-party raw data retain their original licenses.
